intro.text: A half-hearted member of the Set, serving aboard one of its warships.

items.text: In 348 PC Wellid volunteered to crew the Pewternaut A16 from Bilming to Elendel and was set to keep watch on deck. Unnerved by the mists and odd noises, he opened his lantern to peer at the water and was scolded by Gabria. Then Wax and Wayne climbed aboard in front of him; Wax held Vindication on him and demanded to know where the bomb was. When Wayne told him to leave the boat, he jumped overboard.

personality.text: Absent-minded and not committed to the Set's cause; he dislikes sailing, and joined the crew because he thought a warship would be the safest place in the conflict between Bilming and Elendel.
